# Browser dependencies

`bubblesets.js` is the unmodified ES module from `bubblesets` 1.0.2, verified against the
npm registry on 2026-11-10. Upstream: https://github.com/JosuaKrause/bubblesets-js.
Apache-2.0; see bubblesets-LICENSE.txt and the source copyright header.

The exact development dependency/lockfile records the distribution. This local copy lets
the Rust viewer run offline without Node or a CDN. On updates, copy the upstream module
and licence together and verify the package copy matches.
